name: ablation.protocol
reason: same folds, same files, same model settings as the main cross-validation; only the feature columns change

name: ablation.interpretation
reason: a group whose 'only:' score is near the all-groups score carries most of the signal; a group whose 'without:' score is near the all-groups score adds little. Differences are on the same folds, so they are paired comparisons, but they are not independent tests: no p-value is claimed here

name: redundancy.policy
reason: flagged pairs are reported in feature_redundancy.csv and never dropped: dropping columns on the pooled matrix would use test-fold information
